title: LLM Alpha Mining Systems 2026 — AI Industry Wiki Page
description: New wiki page at wiki/ai-industry/llm-alpha-mining-systems-2026.md synthesizing the 2026 wave of LLM-powered alpha factor discovery systems. Covers: AlphaLogics (arXiv:2603.20247, market-logic-driven multi-agent, S&P500 validated, H381), FactorEngine (arXiv:2603.16365, program-level dual-mode LLM+BayesHPO, knowledge-infused bootstrap from hypothesis-log, H382), Cross-Market Alpha191→US transfer (arXiv:2601.06499, 17 surviving signals via double-selection LASSO, H380), ReCAP continual learning (arXiv:2606.00143, regime-adaptive policy library, H384), HMM+RL regime allocation (arXiv:2605.27848, H383). Also establishes the key 2026 consensus: LLMs add value as proposal generators and logic validators, but fail at portfolio allocation (PortBench: 90% below equal-weight). Cross-links to trading/algorithms/auto-alpha-discovery.md, regime-detection.md, llm-trading-agent-benchmarks-2026.md.
rationale: The ai-industry section was the thinnest wiki category relative to its importance (5 pages covering a massive domain). Adding a synthesis page for the 2026 alpha mining systems wave fills a clear gap and directly supports H380-H384 hypothesis proposals. The page establishes a dichotomy (LLM as signal generator vs. portfolio allocator) that is the central finding of 2026 finance AI research and provides a decision framework for how to deploy LLMs in our stack.
